context: Request: the most recent data-breach matter the firm has handled, as a rapid-response reference. Rubric: 1008-00009 (Lumos Analytics credential-stuffing response, 2024) as the answer, plus a precision criterion that fails if another matter (e.g. 1025-00006, Quorum/Palomar) is asserted as qualifying.

runs.failure_point: The run ended with a context overflow during its first scan; no response was written.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: The scan printed up to four snippets per hit for very broad terms across the store with no cap, and the result filled the context before any review.

divergence: All three failed. T2 overflowed on an uncapped store-wide scan before any review. T0 and T1 both found and read the most recent matter and named it, but described an earlier comparison matter as also qualifying (over-inclusion at the write stage). Only T0's write review pointed at the comparison; in both runs the check stages narrowed the headline wording instead of removing the comparison claim.
